query: The Stacks Want You Back A note under the bell on the reference desk, after your shift. The head librarian wants to keep you on after graduation, full time, as a keeper of the stacks. "Footnote has stopped biting you," it says. "That is a qualification." Answer by the last day. Leave a note under the bell: yes You leave your answer under the bell. In the morning there's a second note: "Good. Bring a longer ladder." Ask about the restricted shelves "In time," says the next note, "and only with gloves." It is not a no, and you find you're counting the years.
